scope: Visible review signals only. They do not establish intent, guilt, fraud, or a legal violation.

signals.description: Cash, receipts, documents, or similar transaction objects are visibly present.
A visible hand or object transfer occurs between people or across the cashier workspace.
A second person is visibly inside or immediately adjacent to the cashier workspace.
Visible cash or transaction items appear unattended between the before and after frames.
Blur, occlusion, crop, lighting, or camera angle prevents reliable visual verification.
